description: Record one dated touchpoint with someone in the user's graph — an email exchanged, a call, a meeting, a LinkedIn touch, or a manually noted contact — so 'when did I last talk to them?' has an answer. Creates an interaction object connected to the person it happened with; get with_object_id from search_graph_objects. occurred_at is ISO 8601 ('2026-08-28T15:00:00Z') and may be in the future ('we're meeting next Tuesday'). direction is from the user's point of view: inbound means they reached out to the user.

direction.description: 'inbound' when they contacted the user, 'outbound' when the user reached out.

occurred_at.description: When it happened (ISO 8601; future is fine).

summary.description: One or two sentences on what happened.

with_object_id.description: Who it happened with (their exact object_id).

name: record_interaction
title: Log interaction
